name: Knifefish
maker: General Dynamics Mission Systems and Bluefin Robotics
def: Propeller driven autonomous underwater vehicle for mine countermeasures, developed by General Dynamics Mission Systems and Bluefin Robotics for the United States Navy.
facts: First unveiled at a Navy exposition in April 2012
Meant to take over mine hunting from the Navy's trained dolphins and sea lions
Used by the United States in the 2026 Strait of Hormuz campaign
